sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#3B82F6', "icon" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'wallet', "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#6366F1', "icon" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'category', "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "time_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "date_confirmed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("date_confirmed" IN (0, 1)), "to_account_id" TEXT NULL, "to_amount" INTEGER NULL, "to_currency" TEXT NULL, "exchange_rate" REAL NULL, "balance_after" INTEGER NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#69F0AE', "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("transaction_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_filters" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "config" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dashboard_widgets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "filter_id" TEXT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "width" TEXT NOT NULL, "options" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'singleton', "last_server_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "dashboard_seeded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dashboard_seeded" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tombstones" ("entity_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("entity_table", "entity_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "voice_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "ended_explicitly" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("ended_explicitly" IN (0, 1)), "resume_handle" TEXT NULL, "resume_handle_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "remote_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("remote_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "remote_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("remote_synced" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "voice_session_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "modality" TEXT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "raw_json" TEXT NULL, "binary_data" BLOB NULL, "binary_mime_type" TEXT NULL, "remote_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("remote_synced" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("session_id", "sequence"));
